CustomField.description: This field is used in Flow - "Create Case if FO Stuck in Order Acknowledged". This wfield will calculate time when case is should be created.This field is usefull when FO is of 'KIT' record.
CustomField.formula:
IF( WEEKDAY(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)) == 1, DATETIMEVALUE(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) + 2)+(10/24), If(WEEKDAY(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)) == 7, DATETIMEVALUE(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) + 3)+(10/24),
IF( WEEKDAY(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate + (30/24))) == 1 || WEEKDAY(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate + (30/24))) == 7, CreatedDate+ (78/24), CreatedDate + (30/24))))
CustomField.label: If Eligible - Case will be created on
